summary: Alan Harper was an incumbent Democrat representing Alabama House District 61 in the 2010 election. He recorded approximately +24.1 OOF CMO as a candidate and later switched to the Republican Party in 2012, becoming part of the state's GOP supermajority.
important_caveats: The memo notes that his party switch in 2012 is not pre-election evidence for the 2010 vote.
Harper's Shor-McCarty score was -0.105, placing him at the 71st conservative percentile of the active Alabama Democratic House caucus.
